title: About BharatkiEconomy
intro: BharatkiEconomy is an interdisciplinary research platform dedicated to evidence-based public policy and economic analysis for India. We operate at the intersection of law, economics, policy, and finance.
missionFull: Our mission is to democratize high-rigor research and datasets for all stakeholders in India's growth story. By removing paywalls and academic jargon, we empower civic and market actors with the critical information needed to make informed decisions and foster sustainable development.
editorialStandards: We maintain strict editorial independence and rigorous standards. Every piece of research begins with a clear thesis. All factual claims are supported by primary source citations. We prioritize zero-fluff directives, prioritizing clarity and accuracy over rhetoric.
teamDescription: Our diverse team of researchers, economists, legal scholars, and data scientists brings deep expertise and a shared commitment to unbiased analysis.
antiAudienceStatement: We strictly prohibit clickbait, partisan messaging, sensationalized headlines, and ad-hominem framing. Our platform serves those seeking objective truths, not echo chambers.
